title: Security Ordering of Beth-4 and Elisabeth-4
summary: The paper estimates attack complexities for Beth-4, but whether Beth-4 is at most as secure as Elisabeth-4 for the analyzed attacks remains unresolved.

formal_statement.body: Prove or refute that Beth-4 is at most as secure as Elisabeth-4 against the attacks considered in the paper.

scope.domain: Comparative structural cryptanalysis of Beth-4, a stream-cipher variant of Elisabeth-4 that replaces some modulo-16 additions with coordinate-wise XOR.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Prove or refute the conjectured security ordering for the algebraic, correlation, and guess-and-determine attacks analyzed in the paper.

citations.label: Towards Case-Optimized Hybrid Homomorphic Encryption -Featuring the Elisabeth Stream Cipher-

progress.summary: The source introduces Beth-4 as an easier-to-analyze variation of Elisabeth-4 and explicitly conjectures that it is at most as secure. It then assumes this ordering when using Beth-4 attack-complexity estimates as lower bounds for Elisabeth-4.
citation_labels: Orel Cosseron et al., Towards Case-Optimized Hybrid Homomorphic Encryption -Featuring the Elisabeth Stream Cipher-
